description: This file defines interfaces for browser control and web browser functionalities within the WPEFramework, including URL management, visibility, cookies, scripting, security, and event notifications.

classes.name: IBrowser
classes.description: Interface for direct browser manipulation, including URL setting, FPS retrieval, and visibility control.

classes.name: IWebBrowser
classes.description: Extended interface for web browser with events for page load, URL changes, visibility, and scripting.

classes.name: IBrowserResources
classes.description: Interface for managing browser resources like headers, user scripts, and style sheets.

classes.name: IBrowserSecurity
classes.description: Interface for security settings such as security profile and mixed content policy.

classes.name: IBrowserScripting
classes.description: Interface for executing JavaScript and managing user scripts.

classes.name: IBrowserCookieJar
classes.description: Interface for managing browser cookies, including notifications for changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for browser events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink for browser events.

methods.name: SetURL
methods.description: Sets the URL displayed in the browser.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Retrieves the current URL loaded in the browser.

methods.name: GetFPS
methods.description: Retrieves the current framerate of the browser rendering.

methods.name: Hide
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of the browser.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Event indicating the page has finished loading.

methods.name: URLChange
methods.description: Event indicating the URL has changed.

methods.name: PageClosure
methods.description: Event indicating the page requests to close.

methods.name: HeaderList
methods.description: Gets or sets headers for requests.

methods.name: UserAgent
methods.description: Gets or sets the UserAgent string.

methods.name: LocalStorageEnabled
methods.description: Gets or sets local storage availability.

methods.name: HTTPCookieAcceptPolicy
methods.description: Gets or sets HTTP cookie accept policy.
